about: Ancient places from the Pleiades gazetteer (https://pleiades.stoa.org), licensed CC BY 3.0: 'Pleiades: A Gazetteer of Past Places', ed. R. Talbert, T. Elliott, S. Gillies and others. Settlements located inside the map, as [lon, lat, importance (links to other places, +10 for cities Pleiades calls urban), Pleiades id, from year, to year, names], each name [from year, to year, name] as Pleiades attests it. In a year a place shows the newest name attested then, or else the newest one known before (Poseidonia in 300 BC, Paestum under Rome); modern-language names and names first attested after 1700 are left out.
